---
title: "Guide"
---

Each page here runs against small inputs from
[wxylib/fixtures](https://github.com/wxylib/fixtures), a set of test
stores kept with what GDAL itself reads from them. The fixtures are
pinned to one commit, so the pages give the same result on every
build, and where a fixture carries a GDAL oracle the page checks
gdalxarray against it: if a read drifts, the site fails to build.

[Open modes](modes.qmd)
: Classic rasters with bands as a dimension or as variables, and
  multidimensional arrays with named dimensions.

[Virtual paths](virtual-paths.qmd)
: Local files, `/vsicurl/`, `ZARR:` array and slice syntax, `NETCDF:`
  subdatasets and `vrt://` options, all through the same call.

[Byte-reference stores](byte-refs.qmd)
: A multidimensional VRT mosaic over netCDF files, the byte table
  behind it, and kerchunk-Parquet Zarr.

[Warping](warp.qmd)
: `gdalxarray.warp()` builds a VRT recipe; xarray opens it lazily.

[Curvilinear grids](curvilinear.qmd)
: Swaths and ocean model grids placed by 2D longitude and latitude,
  warped by geolocation arrays.

[Georeferencing conventions](conventions.qmd)
: Which Zarr georeferencing conventions this GDAL recognises, in each
  open mode, measured at build time.
